title: 第25章 一记闷棍第26章 你的桀骜不驯呢
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
斜阳西沉，天色渐暗。
古城的喧嚣渐渐褪去，街道上灯火通明，行客们三三两两的走进酒家，推杯换盏，欢声笑语。
天香楼三层，沈云两人坐在窗台边，悠闲的吃起了晚饭。
大厅古色古香，墙壁悬挂山水字画，梁柱雕饰云纹瑞兽。
最中间是开阔的戏台，几名面容姣好的秀女在抚琴唱戏，余音绕梁。
沈武德手拿大猪蹄子，边啃边吐槽道：“这小子挺会享受，吃饭还挑个雅间。”
沈云拿着茶杯在指尖转动，看向对角处喝酒听曲的上官漠，不疾不徐道：“他应该是在监视上官念。”
追踪了一下午，上官漠都远远跟随着上官念，不难猜出他的目的。
沈武德玩味道：“没想到上官家竟起了内讧，他们那一套确实让人反感。”
打开了话匣子，他开始畅所欲言。
“上官家为了利益无所不用其极，信奉那套自我牺牲，不过确实是有两把刷子，上官玄三甲子就突破了金丹境，没想到又冒出来了更厉害的上官东君…”
沈云静静聆听，旋即提出疑问，“你知道孤鸿剑宗的入门考核吗？”
听到问话，沈武德不假思索道：“作为天澜州的最强霸主，孤鸿剑宗每三年会举行入宗考核，用来补充新鲜血液，下一次应该就在明年年初。”
说到这，他咂吧了一下嘴，“听说上官东君已是内门弟子，在剑宗也算一个人物，看来上官家是想加大投入，扶持他成为真传弟子。”
何为真传？得到了宗门传承，被视作接班人才叫真传弟子。
若是上官东君成为真传，上官家必将如虎添翼，称霸沧浪不再是纸上谈兵。
上官漠喝酒听曲，一副悠然自得的样子，心中却保持着警醒。
‘离开家族我们不过是无根浮萍，既然你不明白，那我只能行非常手段了。
上官漠暗下决心，只要上官念出城就立刻出手，先将她带回家族再说。
他对家主充满了信心，只要将上官念带回去，不怕她不就范。

‘沧浪山迟早是上官家的天下，谁也阻止不了。
上官漠志得意满，视线看向窗外，不久后目标出现了。
他猛地长身而起，随手扔下三块中品灵石，迅速下楼离去。
见状沈云二人也缓缓起身，神不知鬼不的跟在他身后。
月落乌啼，夜黑风高。
上官念心绪复杂，今天拒绝了荒木婆婆的命令，无异于对抗家族的威严。
“还是早点出发，到大周与师兄汇合。”
上官念压下了心头的烦躁，前往天微山外的驿站，那里有沈家的传送道台。
月光洒落在石子路面，道旁的树木轻轻摇曳，上官念施展轻身诀，步伐迅速又不失飘逸。
离开坊市已远，路上已经看不到行人，静谧的山林显得格外阴森。
蓦然间，上官念停步回望，凝重道：“跟了我一路了，出来吧。”
咚，咚！
清脆的脚步声响起，上官漠从地平线上信步而来，神态狂傲且肆意。
见到来者，上官念微微一怔，“这么晚了，你跟着我做什么。”
上官漠好整以暇的拍了拍手，玩味一笑道：“没有人能违背家族意愿，念姐知道的不是吗？”
上官念没有接茬，凉风吹动着额前的青丝，露出清丽恬静的面庞，秋水般的眸子满是坚定。
上官漠伸出了手掌，猛然握拳道：“既然你冥顽不灵，那就别怪我不顾姐弟之情了。”
只见他双拳一振，从身上飞出一块黑色巨石，迎风高长，瞬间化作了两丈高的小山，对着上官念当头压下。
唰！
凌厉的破空声在夜空炸响，上官念身形猛退，口述法咒，指尖四道灵符同时发光。
content_en:
The sun is setting in the west and the sky is getting dark.
The hustle and bustle of the ancient city gradually faded away, the streets were brightly lit, and travelers walked into the restaurant in twos and threes, changing glasses and laughing happily.
On the third floor of Tianxiang Building, Shen Yun and the two sat by the window sill and had dinner leisurely.
The hall is antique, with landscape calligraphy and paintings hanging on the walls, and beams and columns carved with cloud patterns and auspicious animals.
In the middle is an open stage, where several pretty girls are playing the piano and singing, with lingering sounds.
Shen Wude held a big pig's trotter in his hand, chewing on it and complaining: "This kid really knows how to enjoy it. He even chooses a private room to eat."
Chen Yun turned the tea cup on his fingertips, looked at Shangguan Mo who was drinking and listening to music in the opposite corner, and said calmly: "He should be monitoring Shangguan Nian."
After tracking him all afternoon, Shangguan Modu followed Shangguan Nian from a distance. It was not difficult to guess his purpose.
Shen Wude said playfully: "I didn't expect that there would be internal strife in the Shangguan family. Their behavior is really disgusting."
Opening up the conversation, he began to speak freely.
"The Shangguan family will do anything for their own interests and believe in self-sacrifice. However, they do have two tricks. Shangguan Xuan broke through the golden elixir realm in just three years. Unexpectedly, an even more powerful Shangguan Dongjun appeared..."
Shen Yun listened quietly and then asked a question, "Do you know the entrance examination of Guhong Sword Sect?"
Upon hearing the question, Shen Wude said without hesitation: "As the strongest overlord in Tianlan Prefecture, the Guhong Sword Sect holds an entrance examination every three years to replenish fresh blood. The next one should be at the beginning of next year."
Speaking of this, he smacked his lips and said, "I heard that Shangguan Dongjun is already an inner disciple and is considered a figure in the Sword Sect. It seems that the Shangguan family wants to increase investment and support him to become a true disciple."
What is true biography? Those who have received the sect's inheritance and are regarded as their successors are called true disciples.
If Shangguan Dongjun becomes the true successor, the Shangguan family will be even more powerful, and dominating Canglang will no longer be just a matter of paper.
Shangguan Mo looked relaxed and content while drinking and listening to music, but he remained alert in his heart.
‘We are nothing but rootless duckweeds without the family. Since you don’t understand, I can only resort to extreme measures.
Shangguan Mo secretly made up his mind to take action as soon as Shangguan wanted to leave the city and take her back to the family first.
He was full of confidence in the head of the family, and as long as he brought Shangguan Nian back, he was not afraid that she would not obey.
‘Sooner or later, Canglang Mountain will belong to the Shangguan family, and no one can stop it.
Shangguan Mo was very proud and looked out the window. Not long after, the target appeared.
He stood up suddenly, threw down three middle-grade spiritual stones, and quickly went downstairs to leave.
Seeing this, Shen Yun and the other two slowly stood up and followed him unawares.
The moon sets and the crow crows, the night is dark and the wind is high.
Shangguan Nian was in a complicated mood. His refusal of Granny Araki's order today was tantamount to defying the majesty of the family.
"It's better to leave early and meet up with senior brother in Dazhou."
Shangguan Nian suppressed the irritability in his heart and headed to the inn outside Tianwei Mountain, where the Shen family's teleportation platform was located.
The moonlight shone on the gravel road, and the trees beside the road swayed gently. Shangguan Nian used the light body technique, and his steps were fast and elegant.
We were far away from Fangshi, there were no pedestrians on the road, and the quiet mountain forest looked particularly eerie.
Suddenly, Shangguan Nian stopped and looked back, solemnly saying: "You have followed me all the way, come out."
Boom, boom!
Crisp footsteps sounded, and Shangguan Mo strolled over from the horizon, looking arrogant and wanton.
Shangguan Nian was slightly startled when he saw the person coming, "It's so late, why are you following me?"
Shangguan Mo clapped his hands in a leisurely manner and said with a playful smile: "No one can go against the family's wishes. Sister Nian knows that, right?"
Shangguan Nian didn't answer. The cool breeze blew the blue hair on his forehead, revealing a beautiful and tranquil face, and his autumn-like eyes were full of determination.
Shangguan Mo stretched out his palm, clenched his fist suddenly and said, "Since you are so stubborn, don't blame me for ignoring the love between brother and sister."
I saw him shaking his fists and flying out from his bodyA black boulder, tall and tall in the wind, instantly turned into a two-foot-high hill, pressing down on Shangguan Nian head-on.
Uh-huh!
The sharp sound of breaking through the air exploded in the night sky. Shangguan Nian retreated sharply, dictating a spell, and the four talismans on his fingertips glowed at the same time.
